reason: A covers the core contexts (execution-phase apoptosis, PI/AKT/PTEN signalling, intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis) in four clear themes. B adds a relevant nuclear-import facet but piles up five near-duplicate PIP/PTEN/AKT themes and an off-target p53 G2-checkpoint theme.

B keeps the osteoblast, Wnt/MSC-collagen, RUNX2, cartilage/joint and BMP-mesenchyme contexts in 10 themes. In A, about 33 near-duplicate bone/cartilage themes bury its one extra tendon-relevant collagen-fibril/elastic-fibre theme.

Both cover cardiomyocyte growth/regeneration, heart morphogenesis, cardiac fibrosis, hypertrophy/calcineurin, vascular smooth muscle and myogenesis. B repeats the heart-morphogenesis context in about seven near-identical themes and adds little new.

B has the same presynaptic facets in 16 themes: Ca2+ entry and fusion, priming/docking and the release cycles, GPCR/kainate presynaptic modulation, inhibitory synapse, synaptic adhesion and plasticity. A spreads them over about 35 heavily overlapping variants and adds little beyond vesicle recycling.

A covers lipopeptide/LTA sensing, LPS-CD14 transfer, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency, monocyte inflammatory response, NOD/inflammasome and cytokine regulation in 9 themes. B repeats these across about 20 near-duplicate monocyte/TLR variants for only minor extras such as CXCL chemokines and oxLDL.

Both build the same ladder: MPS disorders, then GAG degradation, then lysosomal glycan catabolism, then GAG biosynthesis/glycosylation disorders. B adds redundant giant glycosylation themes (114, 152, 180) and an extra 53/63 pair, while A reaches the same levels with fewer near-duplicates.
